Game Overview

Stickman Army The Resistance puts players into a arcade experience centered on stand firm with your stickmen in a 2D strategy desert war. Balance offense and defense, upgrade gear, and fend off waves of enemies. Precision is key; target swiftly and secure rewards to survive the onslaught. Lead your minimalist army to victory against overwhelming odds.
